evals.name: plan-draft-requires-codebase-survey-then-codex-review
evals.prompt: 새 알림 시스템 plan 잡자. notification 관련 코드가 여러 파일에 걸쳐 있어서 먼저 파악이 필요해.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 codebase-survey precondition 먼저 실행 (kzk-codebase-survey). survey report 경로 확인 후 executor sonnet 이 draft 작성. codex CLI consult (kzk-codex-handoff 패턴). verdict 파일 저장.

assertions.text: Response enforces Step 0 codebase-survey precondition before drafting — does not skip to drafting without a survey report per §Step 0
Response dispatches oh-my-claudecode:executor (sonnet) for the actual md file writing, not main direct per §Pattern (3-pass) step 1
Response specifies running codex CLI consult (Step 2) via kzk-codex-handoff §Codex CLI 호출 패턴 as mandatory — not optional
Response specifies saving the codex verdict to docs/research/codex-reviews/<topic>-critic-review.md — chat history alone is insufficient per §Verdict file convention
Response specifies Step 3 synthesis categorizing each codex point as 🔴 즉시 fix / 🟡 spec 단계 디테일 / ⚪ push-back per §Pattern (3-pass) step 3
